blocks.x: Mark your calendars: the cutest fall event in New York City is officially making its return! Organizers of the annual Tompkins Square Halloween Dog Parade have announced the beloved furry spectacle will take over the East Village for its 36th iteration on Saturday, October 17, 2026.
While the iconic Village Halloween Parade remains a staple on every NYC fall bucket list, there’s a distinct, chaotic joy to this pup-focused event that instantly gives us the zoomies.

Led by New York Dog Parade—a nonprofit dedicated to celebrating dog-human friendship—and presented by Kismet, the premium pet lifestyle brand founded by John Legend and Chrissy Teigen, this year’s event promises to be one of the most vibrant yet.
Here’s everything you need to know about the 2026 parade, from securing your dog’s spot in the competition to celebrating the city’s adoptable rescues.

Shutterstock / Inspired By Maps
What to Expect at the 2026 Tompkins Square Halloween Dog Parade

The world’s biggest Halloween event for canines is fittingly held near NYC’s first-ever dog run in Tompkins Square Park. Thousands of New Yorkers and their elaborately costumed dogs will transform Avenue B into a runway of four-legged fashion.
The competition is famously creative, and 2026 will be no exception. Fern Watt, founder of New York Dog Parade, stated:

Someone emailed us to say they were dressing their dog as frozen yogurt. So clearly, the competition this year is going to be stiff. There’s a lot that can feel heavy in the world right now, but somewhere in New York City, someone is crafting a frozen yogurt costume for their dog. We do find hope in that.

Shutterstock / Donald Bowers Photography
Alongside the legendary costume competition, the 2026 event will feature a massive public festival block packed with special activations. Attendees can expect:
Kismet Activations: Photo opportunities, giveaways, and plenty of Kismet “Nugs” for costumed canine marchers
Live Competition Broadcast: For the first time, dog lovers outside of the city will be able to follow the high-stakes costume competition live
Sponsor Pop-Ups: Activations and surprises from Fetch Pet Insurance, Earth Rated, Mrs. Meyer’s Clean Day for Pets, Allegra, and VEG (Veterinary Emergency Group)
Spotlighting Adoptable Rescues
Because October is Adopt a Shelter Dog Month, the Tompkins Square Halloween Dog Parade is using its massive platform to help pups in need find their forever homes.

New York Dog Parade is partnering with the ASPCA and Animal Care Centers of NYC (ACC) to spotlight adoptable dogs throughout the month. The parade itself will serve as a celebration of rescue dogs, with shelter pups taking part in the festivities to raise awareness for adoption across the five boroughs.

Shutterstock / DonTheMoment
Registration & Event Details

Due to the parade’s immense popularity and limited capacity inside Tompkins Square Park, participation in the legendary Costume Competition will be limited to select registered participants this year.
If you want your dog to march, you must register in advance!
What: The 36th Annual Tompkins Square Halloween Dog Parade
Where: Tompkins Square Park, East Village (Avenue B)
When: Saturday, October 17, 2026
How to Participate: Registration opens Wednesday, September 25 at 12 pm ET at NYDogParade.org. Spots are heavily limited and will be filled on a strict first-come, first-served basis

Additional judges, programming, route specifics, and spectator details will be announced in the coming weeks. Whether you’re entering your own pup or just coming to spectate, prepare for the cutest, spookiest afternoon the East Village has to offer!

The post NYC’s 36th Tompkins Square Halloween Dog Parade returns this October with adoptable rescues appeared first on Secret NYC.
